name: TEMPLATE-KO-PHRASING
blocked_reason: BLOCKED_DATASET: no authorized curated dataset exists yet
hypothesis: LoRA adaptation on authorized modern Korean vocal material shifts the model's phrasing prior away from trot-like delivery.
hypothesis_notes: This is a hypothesis, not a finding. The Phase 20 objective baseline measured spectral and stereo properties; it did not measure stylistic phrasing.
The Phase 20H blind human listening that would bear on this was deliberately deferred and has zero scores recorded. Nothing quantitative supports or refutes the hypothesis today.
The anti-trot probe prompts (TROT-01..04) exist in the P20 benchmark, but that benchmark is evaluation material and must never enter training.
target_failure_mode: trot-like stylistic prior in Korean vocal delivery

dataset_profile_requirements.rights: every selected track must carry commercial_training_allowed = TRUE
notes: Genre and mood targets are omitted deliberately: those fields come from operator sidecars and coverage is currently too sparse for a target to be evaluated.
No trot/non-trot label exists in the manifest, so the target failure mode cannot yet be measured directly in the dataset profile.

training_strategy.rationale: start small; the installed trainer supports LoRA and LoKR only, and no full fine-tune entry point exists.
sequence: SMOKE first, to prove plumbing on the rented host
LORA_SMALL to see whether the dataset moves the model at all
LORA_STANDARD only after the small run produces a loadable checkpoint

evaluation_requirements: Blind A/B listening against the frozen P20 baseline using the existing Phase 20H rubric and tooling.
The P20 benchmark set must be registered as evaluation-only so the leakage gate bars it from training.
Objective finishing-engine measurements are not a substitute for listening on a stylistic hypothesis.

promotion_criteria_placeholders.reason: Numeric thresholds set before any evidence exists would be arbitrary, and would then be treated as targets. They are defined in the evaluation phase, from a measured baseline distribution.
required_before_setting: a completed blind human baseline on the current model
an agreed rubric dimension that captures the target failure mode
a measured inter-run variance, so a threshold can distinguish signal from noise

prohibitions: no P20 benchmark material in training
no automatic promotion on run completion
